## 地圖

下面是可互動的地圖範例，換成你自己的資料即可。

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
library(leaflet)

leaflet() |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  setView(lng = -4.2518, lat = 55.8642, zoom = 13) |>
  addCircleMarkers(lng = -4.2518, lat = 55.8642,
                   radius = 8, color = "#23455A", fillColor = "#F2B84B",
                   fillOpacity = 0.9, popup = "[地點名稱]")
```
